title: IT Auditing and IT Fraud Detection
overview: In today’s digital age, preventing and investigating IT fraud has become a critical aspect of corporate operations. Auditors need specialized skills to tackle the unique challenges posed by IT-related fraud. This course equips internal auditors with the expertise required to prevent, detect, deter, and report IT fraud effectively. Participants will gain insights into key topics such as the role and skills of IT fraud auditors, the nature of computer fraud, predication, and legal considerations in fraud investigations.
audience: This course is designed for IT auditors working in high-risk fraud environments. It is also ideal for internal auditors seeking an in-depth understanding of IT fraud detection and computer-based fraud prevention.
methodology: This interactive course employs a blend of presentations, case studies, discussions, role-plays, videos, and hands-on exercises to enhance participants’ practical skills.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define various types of IT and computer-related fraud.
Identify antifraud controls and assess their effectiveness.
Recognize fraud risks posed by advanced technologies.
Apply effective detection methods for different IT fraud types.
Understand the advantages and limitations of audit software in IT fraud investigations.
